summary: This page is the Table of Contents for the SGX REIT annual report, listing sections from Corporate Profile to Additional Information without containing any schema-relevant data such as financial statements, portfolio details, or distribution highlights. no schema-relevant data

This page presents the SGX REIT's high-quality portfolio of 13 prime U.S. office properties with a total net lettable area of 4.2 million sq ft, detailed in two tables: a Geographical Diversification table showing cash rental income by primary market (top asset is Atlanta at 12.1%) and an Asset Diversification table listing carrying value by asset (top asset is 222 Main at 15.1%). The reporting period is as of 31 December 2025, with key milestones including an occupancy increase to 82.7% and a distribution payout ratio rising from 10% to 65%.
This page presents the SGX REIT's FY2025 DPU (US cents) of 0.61 alongside financial highlights showing Total Assets at US$1.44B, Net Asset Value at US$754.9M, and Aggregate Leverage at 45.0%.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for PRIME features a narrative summary with no audited Portfolio Statement, financial tables, or tenant mix data. It details that as at 31 December 2025, NAV increased to US\$754.9 million (US\$0.53 per unit) and leverage stood at 45.0%, while distributions rose to a total DPU of 0.61 US cents comprising an advanced distribution from July to October 2025 and a final distribution from October to December 2025.
